title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. translated_title: ScenePilot：面向文本驱动3D室内场景生成的“生长-修复”策略
translated_abstract: 文本驱动的3D室内场景生成已经从基于数据集的布局建模发展到利用大型语言模型和视觉-语言模型的开放词汇合成。然而，现有方法仍然存在局限：单次生成器往往产生几何上无效的布局，繁重的后处理优化成本高昂且不稳定，而仅依赖提示词的规划器缺乏用于功能分组和物体关系的可复用布局先验。我们提出了ScenePilot，一个检索增强的“生长-修复”框架，将场景生成表述为先验引导的增量生长与学习到的修正相结合。给定一个提示词，分层检索增强规划（HRAP）模块检索房间级、组级和锚点级的布局先验，以支持功能组规划。随后，文本驱动的基础生成器依次插入物体组，同时强化多模态修复（RMR）模块在每次插入后执行轻量级的局部修正。
tldr: 提出了ScenePilot框架，通过分层检索增强规划（HRAP）和强化多模态修复（RMR），将文本驱动的3D室内场景生成表述为先验引导的增量生长与轻量级修复过程，解决了现有单次生成布局无效、后处理优化昂贵且缺乏可复用布局先验的问题。
en_tdlr: ScenePilot introduces a retrieval-augmented Grow-and-Repair framework that formulates text-driven 3D indoor scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with lightweight learned rectification, addressing invalid layouts, costly post-hoc optimization, and the lack of reusable layout priors in existing methods.
